problem_statement: Return the number of decimal digits in n. n is a non-negative integer (excluding bool). For n = 0 return 1.
valid_input_domain: Return the number of decimal digits in n. n is a non-negative integer (excluding bool). For n = 0 return 1.
bug_explanation: The faulty solution uses while n > 1 instead of while n > 0, so the loop exits one iteration early when n reaches 1, undercounting by 1.
